headline: as far as I know 表示据我所知。
takeaway: 用于限定说话人所掌握的信息范围。
levelHint: 人教2019版高中选择性必修二 Unit 2 · 先掌握教材常用义。
studyPlan: 先听读音，结合声音与拼写对照记忆。
按义项阅读例句，比较易混表达。

senses.title: 据我所知
senses.usageNote: 固定表达；并不保证信息完整。

examples.en: As far as I know, the library opens at nine.
examples.zh: 据我所知，图书馆九点开门。

examples.en: As far as I know, she has finished the project.
examples.zh: 据我所知，她已完成项目。

relatedExpressions.similarNote: 易混表达的区别见“近义与易混”。
relatedExpressions.contrastingNote: 具体关系应结合语境判断。

confusions.title: as far as I know 与 as far as I am concerned

example.en: As far as I know, it is open.

items.label: as far as I am concerned

example.en: As far as I am concerned, it is useful.

confusions.takeaway: as far as I know 表示据我所知；as far as I am concerned 表示就我而言。
